For both En-De and En-Fr tasks, we followed the architecture in (Di Gangi et al., 2019b). We use six Transformer layers of size 512 in the encoder and decoder with eight attention heads. The size of feed-forward mechanism is 1024. The embedding layer in the encoder for the AST task contains two layers of 2D CNNs (Lecun et al., 1998) followed by a ReLU activation function.
